A Pokémon Center in the Rouge District.
Along with healing your Pokémon, you can
buy and sell various items here.

A shopping arcade full of boutiques offering
casual styles at affordable prices.

A shopping arcade full of boutiques offering
unique styles for those who are not swayed
by mainstream fashion.

A well-established shopping arcade full of
boutiques that have long offered the finest

A historic shopping arcade full of boutiques

A broad avenue lined with many reputable

A grand, world-class art museum. It lends
out portions of its permanent collection to
museums in other regions as well.

A Pokémon Center in the Vert District. Along
with healing your Pokémon, you can buy and
sell various items here.

A hotel in the Vert District. It rarely sees any
guests, perhaps due to its secluded location
away from the main road.

A laboratory for researching Pokémon. The
acting director offers wonderful rewards if
you assist her with her research.

A tower located in the heart of Lumiose City,
which is in the center of the Kalos region.
It’s nearly one thousand feet tall.

A tower has long stood here in Lumiose City,
which is in the center of the Kalos region.
It once held a two-thousand-year-old device.

A detective agency currently being run by a
woman named Emma, who inherited the
post from its founder.

The office building of Quasartico Inc., a
multinational company from abroad driving
Lumiose City’s urban redevelopment plan.

A local construction company that places
Colorful Screws around the city and offers
rewards to those who collect them.

A plaza in the Vert District. Many Water-type
Pokémon gather in and around its various
pools of water.

This train station was constructed as part of
the urban redevelopment plan. It connects
Lumiose City to the airport.

A plaza offering an orderly sort of beauty. It
was inspired by ancient amphitheaters and
expresses living in harmony with the water.

A distinctive building with a design that was
inspired by the spirit of some far-off region.

This plaza’s central obelisk is eye-catching,
but what most people recall is the sense of
space and openness. It has a long history.

A shuttered café. No one has taken over the
location due to the bad reputation of those
who once ran it. Known for its distinct color.
